name: Sky Ride
address: 3300 J. David Jones Parkway, Suite B

findings.title: Certified Food Protection Manager (CFPM).
findings.citation_text:
2-102.12(A) Certified Food Protection Manager. (A) The PERSON IN CHARGE shall be a certified FOOD protection manager who has shown proficiency of required information through passing a test that is part of an ACCREDITED PROGRAM.

The PIC for this facility has not completed and acquired a CFPM certificate. A hand out was given with current local options for the course/test. They are instructed to acquire a CFPM prior tot he next routine inspection.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting.
findings.citation_text:
2-103.11(P) Person In Charge. The PERSON IN CHARGE shall ensure that: (P) FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES are informed in a verifiable manner of their responsibility to report in accordance with LAW, to the PERSON IN CHARGE, information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD, as specified under 2-201.11(A).

On arrival the PIC could not provide verification of employees being notified of their responsibility to report. The PIC called the food manager and they could not direct them to them either. Fresh copies of the SCDPH Reporting Agreements were given to be signed prior to the follow-up scheduled for 10/27/25.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible.
findings.comment:
(REPEAT x2)6-301.12 Hand Drying Provision. Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels.

The hand sink next to the three part sink is without paper towels at the start of this inspection. Paper towels were supplied to correct.

findings.title: Food separated and protected.
findings.citation_text:
3-302.11(A)(2) Packaged and Unpackaged Food - Separation, Packaging, and Segregation. (A) FOOD shall be protected from cross contamination by: (2) Except when combined as ingredients, separating types of raw animal FOODS from each other such as beef, FISH, lamb, pork, and POULTRY during storage, preparation, holding, and display by: (a) Using separate EQUIPMENT for each type, or (b) Arranging each type of FOOD in EQUIPMENT so that cross contamination of one type with another is prevented, and (c) Preparing each type of FOOD at different times or in separate areas.

A package of raw sausage is observed over containers of Ready-To-Eat sauces in a standing cooler. The PIC was shown and educated. The package was moved to the bottom cooler to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized.
findings.citation_text:
4-601.11(A) Equipment, Food-Contact Surfaces, Nonfood-Contact Surfaces, and Utensils. (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch.

The deflector shield in the ice machine is observed with slime/mold growth. The PIC was shown and cleaned the location to correct.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12: Each HANDWASHING SINK shall be provided with: (A) Individual, disposable towels; (B) A continuous towel system that supplies the user with a clean towel; (C) A heated-air hand drying device; (D) A hand drying device that employs an air-knife system that delivers high velocity, pressurized air at ambient temperatures. 

Both the back and the front hand sinks are without paper towels during this inspection. paper towels were suplied during this inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-601.11: (A) EQUIPMENT FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES and UTENSILS shall be clean to sight and touch. 

Multiple nozzles on the soda fountain machine are observed soiled. PIC indicated that they are cleaned weekly. This does not appear to be sufficient. Clean often enough to maintain free of soilage. The nozzles were cleaned/sanitized during the inspection to correct.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-602.11: (A) FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES shall be cleaned before each use, each time there is a change in work, between uses of raw FOODS to RTE FOODS, before using FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE, and when contamination has occurred. (C) Cleaned at least every 4 hours. 

Multiple utensils are observed stored above the grill and still being soiled. The ice scoop is also observed soiled. The PIC was shown and moved the items back to dish for re-cleaning. Ensure all food contact items are thoroughly cleaned prior to storage and use.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
5-205.11: (A) A HANDWASHING SINK shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for EMPLOYEE use. (B) A HANDWASHING SINK may not be used for purposes other than handwashing. (C) An automatic handwashing facility shall be used in accordance with manufacturer’s instructions. 

The hand sink in the back of the facility is observed with a cart in front of it and a box on top of it. A conversation was had with both PIC and owner and they are instructed to ensure that the hand sinks are always accessible. The items in question were removed to correct the violation.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.11: Each HANDWASHING SINK or group of 2 adjacent HANDWASHING SINKS shall be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. 

The hand sink in the back of the facility is without soap at the beginning of the inspection. Soap was provided to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less. 

The sandwich display case across from the counter is observed warm. Air temperatures are 53F per the attached thermometer and 54F on inspector’s IR thermometer. Internal temperatures were checked and ranged from 53F-58F. Yogurt, hamburgers, sandwiches and mozzarella cheese were discarded from this cooler to correct the violation.

findings.title: Proper cooling methods used; adequate equipment for temperature control
findings.comment:
4-301.11: EQUIPMENT for cooling and heating FOOD, and holding cold and hot FOOD, shall be sufficient in number and capacity to provide FOOD temperatures. 

The cooler noted in line item #33 is not functioning correctly. The cooler will need maintenance/repair prior to being used again for holding TCS foods. Follow up in two weeks for repair/compliance.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-302.14: A test kit or other device that accurately measures the concentration in MG/L of SANITIZING solutions shall be provided. 

Test strips were not available for the sanitizer used in the facility. Follow up in two weeks for compliance.

findings.title: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting
findings.comment:
2-201.11: (A) The PERMIT HOLDER shall require FOOD EMPLOYEES and CONDITIONAL EMPLOYEES to report to the PERSON IN CHARGE information about their health and activities as they relate to diseases that are transmissible through FOOD. Report: Symptoms (all P except lesion), diagnosis (all P), and possible exposures (P).  (E) Responsibility of food employee to report symptoms/disease to PIC. 

Observed no signed employee health reporting agreements. Provided new copy for facility. Ensure employees understand the document and sign. Inspector will follow-up on 12/27/21 (longer than 10 days due to Christmas holiday).

findings.title: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events
findings.comment:
2-501.11: A FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall have written procedures for EMPLOYEES to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the FOOD ESTABLISHMENT. The procedures shall address the specific actions EMPLOYEES must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of EMPLOYEES, consumers, FOOD, and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. Reference 2-501.11.  

Observed no Norovirus illness clean-up policy. Provided new copy. Ensure facility has bleach to perform procedure. Inspector will follow-up on 12/27/21 to check for purchase of bleach (longer than 10 day follow-up due to Christmas holiday).

findings.title: Thermometers provided & accurate
findings.comment:
4-204.112: (A) In refrigerated or hot FOOD storage unit, TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE shall be located to measure air temperature. (B) EQUIPMENT holding TCS FOOD shall have TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE affixed to device. (C) Does not apply to EQUIPMENT without practical means of measuring ambient air surroundings. (D) TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall be designed to be easily readable. C (E) FOOD and water TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICES shall have numerical scale, printed record, or digital readout in increments no greater than 1C or 2F in the intended range of use. Pf

Observed no thermometers in coolers. Provided thermometer for each cooler before next routine inspection.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment:
4-303.11: (A) Cleaning agents used to clean EQUIPMENT shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. (B) Chemical SANITIZERS shall be provided and available during all hours of operation. 

(REPEAT) Observed no sanitizer for the quaternary ammonium test strips available at the facility. Either purchase quaternary ammonium or bleach. If utilizing bleach, bleach should be for food-contact surfaces, have information about parts per million (ppm), and information about an EPA registration number. Bleach test strips should be purchased if utilizing bleach. Inspector will follow-up on 12/27/21 (longer than a 10 day follow-up due to Christmas holiday). This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 3/26/21.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-201.11: Except as specified under § 6-201.14 and except for antislip floor coverings or applications that may be used for safety reasons, floors, floor coverings, walls, wall coverings, and ceilings shall be designed, constructed, and installed so they are SMOOTH and EASILY CLEANABLE. 

(REPEAT) Observed cove base to be coming away on the entire wall of the facility - behind coolers. Seal wall to floor. This is a repeat violation since the last routine inspection on 3/26/21.
